feeds.title: Home Joys
feeds.description: This is the place I share about my life as a mother, homemaker, and daughter of God. Since 2008, I've written about the books I've read, sourdough experiments, garden successes, and various everyday events. I am Gina, a Mennonite mom who writes about books, broccoli, and baking bread.

feeds.title: Shirley Hershey Showalter Blog
feeds.description: Shirley is an author of family oriented books. This blog is in essence a collection of memories from the author.

feeds.title: Finding Harmony Blog
feeds.description: My purpose for Finding Harmony is offering insights (including from others) on how we can all find peace, harmony and all that grand stuff in our daily personal, community and wider world. Melodie M. Davis, the author of the blog is a renowned author of 9 books.

feeds.title: Jennifer Murch
feeds.description: Find articles on daily life, lifestyle, family, Mennonite life, recipes and more! Hi! I'm Jennifer Jo. For the past several years, blogging has been my creative outlet of choice. I'm not always comfortable with this virtual reality business, but that hasn't kept me from hitting the publish button, obviously.

feeds.title: of windowsills and breezy hills Blog
feeds.description: Follow along the daily life of a Mennonite mom. My name is Violet. I was a Yoder before I married my handsome husband.

feeds.title: Properties of Light Blog
feeds.description: Follow along my story and articles on daily life in my blog. Lucinda J. Kinsinger has always viewed herself as a shy little Mennonite girl, but refuses to let that stop her from pursuing what she loves - whether that's writing with honesty and vulnerability or traveling to a remote village in China.

feeds.title: The Practical Mystic
feeds.description: Nancy J. Myers, the practical mystic, lives in southwest Michigan, USA. She is drawn to spiritual experience but always keeps at least one foot in the material world. This blog covers the gamut of her daily experience as a retired writer and editor for great causes; grandmother; world traveler; Midwestern Mennonite; and lover of books, other cultures and languages, nature, and God.

feeds.title: Bethel Moms
feeds.description: MOMs is all about YOU. Our program runs on Thursday mornings and is designed as a 'time out' for busy moms. We hope that you'll enjoy this time of sharing, learning, getting to know other moms - and getting to sit and drink an entire cup of coffee while it's still hot.

feeds.title: Musings of a Mennonite Wife and Mom Blog
feeds.description: Just the musings of a new stay at home mom who's mindset has changed on almost everything, and probably has too much time alone to think. Hi, I'm Luisa. I'm loved and saved by Jesus Christ, Wife of four years, and mom of an 11 month old baby boy.
